title: Xairos Appoints Armen Minasian to Board of Advisors
html:
Insider Brief

  • Xairos Systems has appointed Armen Minasian, founder of Napeague Capital, to its Board of Advisors to support the company’s investment and capital strategy.
  • Minasian brings more than 20 years of public and private market experience and will advise on capital raising and long-term investment planning as Xairos commercialises its Quantum Time Transfer technology.
  • The appointment comes as Xairos works to expand its quantum-based timing technology, which aims to address vulnerabilities in GPS/GNSS systems, including spoofing, jamming and timing disruptions.

PRESS RELEASE — Xairos Systems, Inc. (Xairos), a quantum technology company developing resilient timing and networking solutions, today announced the appointment of Armen Minasian to its Board of Advisors to support investment and capital strategy as the company commercializes its proprietary Quantum Time Transfer (QTT) technology.

Founder of the private investment firm Napeague Capital, Armen brings more than 20 years of public and private market experience to Xairos. Napeague Capital is based in Boulder, Colorado, with operations in major financial hubs including New York, Miami, and London. In this advisory role, Armen will guide the company’s capital-raising efforts and long-term investment strategy, offering a unique and directly applicable perspective.

“Building the future of secure timing requires a robust financial foundation to match our technological breakthroughs. Armen brings a disciplined, long-term perspective on value creation that will help us scale effectively,” said David Mitlyng, Xairos CEO.

“The vulnerabilities in traditional GPS/GNSS timing pose a massive, underappreciated risk to global infrastructure, and Xairos is pioneering a quantum-based solution to address it. Supporting the capital strategy required to scale this critical technology worldwide is deeply gratifying as we work to resolve one of the world’s greatest security threats,” said Armen Minasian, Xairos Board of Advisors.

As market demand surges to protect critical infrastructure against GPS/GNSS spoofing, jamming, and timing disruptions, it is more critical than ever to secure and align capital to scale this breakthrough at speed. Armen’s expertise will be invaluable, enabling Xairos to further deploy its quantum timing technology and scale the company to build a global quantum network.

Mohib Ur Rehman

MENTIONED IN THE ARTICLE

Xairos Systems Inc is a space based quantum technology company founded in 2019 that develops cutting edge timing and synchronization infrastructure for aerospace, telecommunications, and defense applications. The company specializes in creating a global, space based timing architecture using proprietary Quantum Time Transfer technology, which leverages quantum entanglement to deliver sub nanosecond clock precision.
